instructions_coverage.notes: 25 of 31 instructions in instructions.json are exercised by at least one scenario's criteria.json (parseAsync+await, process.argv avoidance, try/catch, typed options passed whole, addCommand, kebab-case, program.opts() subcommand scoping, exitOverride, requiredOption, choices(), version-from-package.json).
